title: 2.7 Numbers 6-10
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
unit_outcome: Recognize common surroundings and identify, count, and describe concrete objects without using untaught location language.
lesson_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
goal: Recognize, hear, and say the number words six through ten and name a number card with It is.
grammar_function: Number word; It is + number for a number card.
prerequisite: 2.6 numbers one to five and It is + number.
speaking_outcome: Say the numbers six to ten and name each number card.
